title: Don't Make This Mistake: What Happens When You Resist Arrest!
description:
On August 28th, 2022, at 9:57 pm, an officer with Edmond Police Department in Oklahoma  was on patrol when they observed a gold-colored vehicle driving 80 MPH in a 45 MPH zone. It was also heavily raining at this time. The officer activated their sirens and began their pursuit of the vehicle to initiate a traffic stop. The suspect was arrested and later charged with Driving Under The Influence (DUI), Failure to Yield to an Emergency Vehicle, Reckless Driving, Resisting Arrest and Speeding.
